Horse massage for everyone. Your SUMCHI Technique journey starts here. Improve your horse performance and well being through massage, unlock fascia, improve circulation and follow the SUMCHI Stroke routine to get the most out of your Sumchi6 Magnetic massager. 

Horse care made available to you, just like grooming your horse this technique becomes a part of your routine. An Equine bodyworker can add this tool to their equine therapy session. 

SUMCHI Technique is based on the behaviour of mutual grooming. Easy to learn strokes that follow the pattern of your horse’s nature. The revolutionary massage strokes work to improve the energy pathways of your horse by helping to balance your horse’s fascia, meridians and muscles.
